verdicts.decision_note: The client requests a reusable document-template system with swappable narrative sections, resizable budget tables, and a client-specific prepared-for line; no project scheduling details are encoded in this Event.

The freelancer explicitly identifies the modular template as outside the quoted one-proposal scope and asks whether to add it now or handle it as a separate project, creating a material scope question.
The client explicitly keeps the current proposal simple and postpones the reusable modular template for future consideration.
